project-manager.note: Shows and explicitly adopts the bound game's exact engine target.

upstream-update-monitor.note: Refreshes versioned knowledge without installing or adopting builds.

game-launch.note: Resolves the bound project target and refuses global-path substitution for non-stable targets.

stage-rig-launch.note: Uses the stage document's bound project target.

test-session-launch.note: Uses the test project's bound engine target.

editor-visibility.note: Capability decisions are available; each editor must declare requirements before being called integrated.

completion-and-snippets.note: No capability-specific completion requirements are declared yet.

generators.note: Existing stable generators remain unchanged; future syntax requires explicit consumer declarations.

screenpack-config.note: Existing stable fields remain unchanged; discovered future fields are informational only.
